narrator.name: Bella
narrator.direction: Warm curiosity, precise consonants. Connect causes to consequences. No announcer voice.

buyer.name: QStar · AgentTab
buyer.direction: Practical, concise and thoughtful. Same buyer-side voice for human buyer and trusted spend service, with explicit speaker labels.

basis_theory.name: Brian
basis_theory.direction: Calm technical authority. Short clean statements, no growl, whisper or reverb. The signer speaks for execution.

merchant.name: Matilda
merchant.direction: Direct and welcoming. State terms cleanly. Warmth follows confirmed settlement, with no sales pitch.

turns.speaker: narrator
phrases: The wallet key stays inside Basis Theory.
turns.text: A buyer needs something. Their agent can buy it, paying in testnet USDC. The wallet key stays inside Basis Theory.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The buyer’s agent shops. A separate spend service decides, reached through fixed tools.

turns.speaker: buyer’s spend service
phrases: and seal only what I approve.
turns.text: I check policy, record each attempt, and seal only what I approve.

turns.speaker: narrator
phrases: Basis Theory has its own signer
and a vault for the key.
turns.text: Basis Theory has its own signer and a vault for the key. Across the line: a merchant, a facilitator, and the chain.

turns.speaker: merchant
phrases: I set the price and payee.
When the buyer asks to pay,
turns.text: I set the price and payee. When the buyer asks to pay, I return the payment requirements.

turns.speaker: buyer’s spend service
phrases: I check the terms against policy,
save one nonce and expiry with the attempt,
turns.text: I check the terms against policy, save one nonce and expiry with the attempt, then seal that intent.

turns.speaker: narrator
phrases: That sealed intent goes to Basis Theory.
turns.text: That sealed intent goes to Basis Theory.

turns.speaker: basis theory signer
phrases: The signature leaves. The key stays with me.
turns.text: I check the seal and my five fixed rules. Then I sign. The signature leaves. The key stays with me.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: With the signature checked, the merchant records the claim. The facilitator verifies, then submits. USDC moves on chain.

turns.speaker: basis theory signer
phrases: The seal is valid, but that payee isn’t allowed.
turns.text: The seal is valid, but that payee isn’t allowed. I won’t sign.

turns.speaker: buyer’s spend service
phrases: I return its receipt. Still one transfer.
turns.text: That attempt is already settled. I return its receipt. Still one transfer.

turns.speaker: narrator
phrases: The wallet key stays with Basis Theory.
nor the merchant holds buyer keys.
turns.text: The wallet key stays with Basis Theory. Other keys have narrower jobs. Management and one-time provisioning stay separate. Neither the agent nor the merchant holds buyer keys.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Policy decides. The signer signs. The chain settles.
